---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for ChatVRM Agent
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

A clear and concise description of **what problem** you are trying to solve.
It is more useful to describe the pain point first than to jump straight to a
proposed solution.

## Proposed solution

A description of the change you would like to see.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you have considered, and why you
prefer the proposed approach.

## Use case

Describe the workflow or scenario where this would be useful. Who benefits
and how?

## Mockups / examples

Screenshots, sketches, code snippets, or links to similar implementations in
other projects.

## Out of scope (optional)

What you explicitly do **not** want this feature to do.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched the existing issues and there is no duplicate
- [ ] I have considered whether the same outcome can be reached with current
      settings
